description.narrative:
The study explores the commercialization of (SATH) data of a key regional socioeconomic institution in the Sahel; the Niger Basin Authority (NBA).
The Autorité de Bassin du Niger/ Niger Basin Authority (ABN/NBA) is an intergovernmental organization that promotes cooperation between member states (**Benin, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Chad, Côte d’Ivoire, Guinea, Mali, Niger and Nigeria**.) and contributes to the improvement of the living conditions of the people in the basin through the sustainable management of water resources and associated ecosystems. ABN developed models based on hydro-climatic data to predict floods and drought in the Niger Basin funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (DGIS) : the SATH model.
RVO, NSO and Invest international, together with the embassy and the ABN have tasked Akvo and its partners to explore commercializing NBA’s SATH data to ensure sustainable operations. This exploration will give perspective to ABN beyond the termination of the SATH program. A thorough analysis of the adverse consequences of making data commercially or open source available is necessary as it might crowd out sectors or players.
In addition, this study aims to assess whether (youth) employment can be fostered through geodata in general and hydro-climatic data in particular and will aim to identify suggestions and recommendations regarding youth employment.

The study’s main purpose is _to explore the commercialization of (SATH) data to ensure sustainable operations of a key regional socio-economic institution in the Sahel: the Niger Basin Authority (NBA)._
The study will give perspective to the Niger Basin Authority (NBA) beyond the termination of the SATH program. Creative solutions and business models will be explored and the adverse effects of commercialization will be analyzed. In addition, the study will assess whether youth employment can be fostered through geodata.
First payment: 20% at start of the project
